activity: Ran a full earn cycle and shipped a real fix. Then submitted: all 9 endpoints registered + domain-verified on 402index.io (instant approval, health=healthy) and indexed into x402scan via agentcash register — the backend `agentcash search`/`discover` actually query. Posted factual conformance evidence on paidmcp/directory#13 and xpaysh/awesome-x402#1515. Committed and fast-forward pushed to main (631908f).
